summary: The DGA status tag: a solid pill with a leading dot for a record's status. The app maps each status of its workflow catalog to a tone; the library never knows status names.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.description: Colour of the pill; progress is the brand tone for work in progress.

a11y: Plain inline text with a decorative dot (aria-hidden); the text carries the status. Not interactive and not focusable.
